error: git rebase --abort bloqueado por miles de untracked Rust build artifacts y FARANDULA media
root_cause: Rebase interactivo lanzado por otro agente sin .gitignore adecuado para target/ dirs y media assets
fix: Mover untracked a /tmp, purgar target/ dirs, luego abort. Si abort falla: git symbolic-ref HEAD + git reset --soft via reflog

error: git index corrupto (index file smaller than expected) tras rebase abort parcial
root_cause: El rebase abort fue cancelado mid-flight dejando el index en estado inconsistente
fix: rm -f .git/index && git symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/<branch> && git reset HEAD -- .

error: test_swarm_queue_contention flakes under pytest-xdist CPU load
root_cause: Using hardcoded time-sleep and waiting on loop iterations rather than awaiting actual enqueuer task completion under resource contention
fix: Utilize asyncio.gather on enqueuer tasks directly, and expand consumer sweep loop limits/timeouts to absorb scheduling latency

error: segfault (SIGSEGV/SIGBUS) when loading cortex_rs under Python 3.14.4
root_cause: ABI mismatch due to cortex_rs compiled library (.so/.dylib) target-compiled for Python 3.12, but imported under Python 3.14.4
fix: Run 'cargo build --release' using the system python/cargo environment matching the active runtime version

error: Remotion headless Chrome OOM SIGKILL and canvas decoding errors on macOS
root_cause: Headless Chromium on macOS runs out of memory with concurrency > 1 and produces corrupted frame packets if GPU acceleration is not explicitly disabled under sandbox environment
fix: Throttle concurrency to 1 and pass --disable-gpu to chromium-flags

error: Incorrect Uniswap reserves swap direction in ASM simulation
root_cause: Added reserve0 and subtracted reserve1, which drove the asset price down instead of up (denominator reserve0 increased)
fix: Subtracted reserve0 and added reserve1 to drive reserves price up for oracle manipulation validation

error: Excepciones en JIT (e.g. ZeroDivisionError) colapsan ByzantineJudge loop de host
root_cause: SandboxJIT except block restringía captura a (ValueError, TypeError, NameError) dejando escapar Exception base
fix: Wrapper termodinámico a base Exception con forzado a JITSandboxViolation para penalizar BFT en vez de crashear Host

error: TypeError: '<=' not supported between instances of 'MagicMock' and 'int'
root_cause: El causal_write context manager incrementa _causal_write_auth_count usando un MagicMock al heredar de conn._conn.
fix: Inicializar explícitamente mock_conn._causal_write_auth_count = 0 y ejecutar del mock_conn._conn antes del bloque with causal_write().

error: Astro check OOM (JavaScript heap out of memory)
root_cause: Strict tsconfig causaba demasiada inferencia Zod/Astro/React components global
fix: Downgrade a astro/tsconfigs/base en tsconfig y override de RAM a 8GB en package.json
